title: Living off the Local Model: Abusing Browser-Embedded Language Models for Post-Exploitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Browsers now ship local language models to ordinary endpoints. Google includes Gemini Nano in Chrome to enable productivity features such as summarization, with inference running entirely on the device. These browser-embedded models provide new living-off-the-land opportunities for attackers, each instance a potential post-exploitation engine already installed, signed by the vendor, and invisible to network monitoring. The Gemini model is multimodal, capable of processing files, analyzing screenshots, or conversing with an attacker. We show that it can be driven from the host using only interpreters that ship with the operating system and find that the one-time user-activation check before the model is downloaded is easily satisfied with a simulated click or bypassed entirely.We measure and report the current model's ability to identify credentials on the host, detect PII in email, classify images, and call custom tools. translated_title: 借力本地模型：滥用浏览器内嵌语言模型进行后渗透攻击
translated_abstract: 浏览器如今向普通终端设备预装本地语言模型。Google在Chrome中集成了Gemini Nano以支持摘要生成等生产力功能，其推理完全在设备端运行。这些浏览器内嵌的模型为攻击者提供了新的“就地取材”攻击机会——每个模型实例都是一个潜在的后渗透攻击引擎，它已经预装在设备上、经过厂商签名、且对网络监控完全不可见。Gemini模型具备多模态能力，能够处理文件、分析截图或与攻击者对话。我们证明，仅使用操作系统自带的解释器即可在主机上驱动该模型，并发现模型下载前的一次性用户激活检查很容易通过模拟点击满足，甚至可以被完全绕过。我们测量并报告了当前模型在识别主机上的凭据、检测电子邮件中的个人身份信息（PII）、分类图像以及调用自定义工具方面的能力。我们结合了……
tldr: 该研究首次揭示了攻击者可以将浏览器预装的本地语言模型（如Chrome中的Gemini Nano）滥用于后渗透攻击阶段，仅借助操作系统自带工具即可驱动其窃取凭据、挖掘敏感信息，且全程躲避网络监控检测。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that attackers can abuse browser-embedded local language models (e.g., Gemini Nano in Chrome) as post-exploitation engines, driving them with only OS-native interpreters to harvest credentials and sensitive data while remaining invisible to network monitoring.
